record.title: Evaluate source serial point compatibility
record.intent: Decide whether the observed control surface is usable or needs a bounded correction.
requirements: Compare candidate framing, transport result and operator screen witness. Do not equate a completed write or absent reply with command acceptance.
Classify UI command interpretation as supported, contradicted, or unresolved; RF qualification and persistence remain separate. Preserve the actual final point/output indication.
Identify the smallest useful continuation for source control or RF preparation, without blind protocol variation, automatic retry, calibration, firmware work or scope interaction.
acceptance: A scoped compatibility conclusion and next action follow the retained evidence.
